newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Smorgon Steel ups capacity 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Smorgon Steel ups capacity 35 pct.

text.p: Australia's Smorgon Steel Pty Ltd said on Friday a A$70 million upgrade had boosted annual production capacity 35 percent to 608,000 tonnes at its Laverton plant in Victoria state.
The upgraded mill produces rod and bar steel for use by Smorgon's downstream businesses.
Smorgon Steel is a major, privately owned integrated steel producer.
Its owners, the Smorgon family, announced in 1995 it wanted to sell the business but has yet make any announcement.
